To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Yap is an essential regulator for the development of salivary gland ductal networks; (2) Yap regulates ductal development through induction of Epiregulin expression; (3) Yap activity is negatively regulated by Lats kinases.
Yap is an essential regulator for ductal progenitor expansion in the mouse SMG and that the Hippo pathway is required for ductal progenitors maturation.

Yap is required to maintain the progenitor state of Krt5-positive epithelial cells in the SMG, which are the progenitors of the ductal epithelium, through regulation of the expression of the EGR family member Epiregin, and that the loss of Yap leads to a reduction in the number of Krt5 positive cells.

the molecular regulation of epithelial morphogenesis and patterning.
understanding the mechanisms that control the development of epithelial organs, and in particular salivary glands.
the development and function of epithelial tissues.
